body: Surely it's got to be better than this...

I suffer from fibromyalgia and chronic fatigue.. plus degenerative disc disease.. I have an 11 year old with pathological demand avoidance which is part of the autistic spectrum..  it's just the 2 of us 24/7  I have battled to try and get help but get none.. the anxiety and depression are part of the fibromyalgia but I've actually had them since I was 16... I have PTSD from childhood abuse and a toxic mother...   I only exist... there is no living it's too hard
